verses.GEN.1.1: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
verses.NUM.6.24: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:
verses.NUM.6.25: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
verses.NUM.6.26: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
verses.JOS.1.9: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.PSA.1.1: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
verses.PSA.1.2: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
verses.PSA.1.3: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
verses.PSA.1.4: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
verses.PSA.1.5: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
verses.PSA.1.6: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.
verses.PSA.23.1: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.PSA.23.2: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
verses.PSA.23.3: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
verses.PSA.23.4: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
verses.PSA.23.5: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
verses.PSA.23.6: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
verses.PSA.46.1: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.PSA.46.10: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
verses.PSA.119.105: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.PSA.121.1: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
verses.PSA.121.2: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
verses.PSA.121.3: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
verses.PSA.121.4: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.PSA.121.5: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.
verses.PSA.121.6: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.PSA.121.7: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
verses.PSA.121.8: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
verses.PRO.1.7: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.PRO.3.1: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:
verses.PRO.3.2: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.
verses.PRO.3.3: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
verses.PRO.3.4: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
verses.PRO.3.5: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
verses.PRO.3.6: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
verses.PRO.4.23: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
verses.PRO.16.3: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
verses.PRO.16.9: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
verses.ISA.40.31: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
verses.JER.29.11: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
verses.LAM.3.22: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
verses.LAM.3.23: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
verses.MIC.6.8: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
verses.MAT.5.3: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.MAT.5.4: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
verses.MAT.5.5: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
verses.MAT.5.6: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
verses.MAT.5.7: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
verses.MAT.5.8: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
verses.MAT.5.9: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
verses.MAT.5.10: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.MAT.6.33: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
verses.MAT.6.34: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
verses.MAT.11.28: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
verses.MAT.11.29: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
verses.MAT.11.30: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
verses.JHN.1.1: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.JHN.1.2: The same was in the beginning with God.
verses.JHN.1.3: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
verses.JHN.1.4: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
verses.JHN.1.5: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
verses.JHN.3.16: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
verses.JHN.14.6: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
verses.JHN.14.27: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
verses.ROM.8.28: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
verses.1CO.13.4: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
verses.1CO.13.5: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
verses.1CO.13.6: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;
verses.1CO.13.7: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
verses.1CO.13.13: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
verses.GAL.5.22: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
verses.GAL.5.23: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
verses.PHP.4.6: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
verses.PHP.4.7: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
verses.PHP.4.13: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
verses.2TI.1.7: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
verses.HEB.11.1: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
